title: Syrian Orange Grilled Chicken with Creamy Gratins
description: A flavorful and refreshing dish that combines the sweetness of orange with the spice of Syrian cuisine. This recipe features grilled chicken breast served with a creamy gratin made with the finest ingredients.
instructions: In a small bowl, whisk together olive oil, garlic, and Syrian spices.
Brush the mixture evenly onto both sides of the chicken breast.
Grill the chicken for 5-6 minutes per side, or until it reaches an internal temperature of 165°F (74°C).
Let the chicken rest for 5 minutes before slicing.
Meanwhile, prepare the creamy gratin by combining goat cheese, heavy cream, and a pinch of salt in a small saucepan.
Heat the mixture over low heat, stirring constantly, until the cheese is melted and the sauce is smooth.
Slice the grilled chicken breast and serve with the creamy gratin and sliced oranges.
Garnish with fresh herbs, if desired.
